traits.habitat_notes: Disturbed ground: fields, gardens, roadsides, railways, waste places, river and lake banks (FNA, FEIS).

taxon.note: Scientific and common names as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form chosen from the plant's habit: one stout erect stem branching above, ending in a dense bristly green panicle of spikes.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species.

allometry.note: 1.0 m tall at 1 years in the open, inside the floras' range of heights, as grown. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Every look comes from the characters through the library's rules: one stout erect stem branching above, ending in a dense bristly green panicle of spikes.

traits.library_form.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Amaranthus retroflexus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): an annual herb: forb.

traits.life_span.note: USFS FEIS, Amaranthus retroflexus species review (fs.usda.gov/database/feis/plants/forb/amaret, read 2026-10-19): a coarse, monoecious annual herb with a taproot; regenerates from seed each year.

traits.woodiness.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Amaranthus (Mosyakin & Robertson) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): herbs.

traits.stem_posture.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Amaranthus retroflexus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): stems erect; underdeveloped or damaged plants rarely ascending to nearly prostrate.

traits.height_typical_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Amaranthus retroflexus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): stems 0.2-1.5(-2) m; FOC 20-80 cm; FEIS 0.3-2 m.

traits.height_max_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Amaranthus retroflexus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): to 2 m.

traits.crown_width_max_m.note: A model estimate (confidence low), as no source read gives it: a large open-grown plant branched in its upper half spreads to about 1 m.

traits.stem_diameter_max_m.note: A model estimate (confidence low), as no source read gives it: FOC calls the stem stout; about 2 cm at the base of a large plant.

traits.root_depth_max_m.note: USFS FEIS, Amaranthus retroflexus species review (fs.usda.gov/database/feis/plants/forb/amaret, read 2026-10-19): taproot; in New Mexico pinyon-juniper woodland root depth averaged 100 cm, range 10-240 cm.

traits.stem_cross_section.note: Flora of China vol. 5 (2003), Amaranthus retroflexus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): stem slightly obtusely angled (var. retroflexus: thick, obtusely angulate).

traits.stem_hairs.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Amaranthus retroflexus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): densely to moderately pubescent, especially the distal stem and branches; FOC densely pubescent.

traits.stem_colour.note: Flora of China vol. 5 (2003), Amaranthus retroflexus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): stem light green; FNA: reddish near the base (the 'red root'); sRGB by eye for 'light green'.

traits.rosette.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Amaranthus retroflexus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leafy erect stem, no basal rosette described.

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Amaranthus (Mosyakin & Robertson) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaves alternate.

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Amaranthus (Mosyakin & Robertson) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaves alternate; spiral assumed as for the genus.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Amaranthus retroflexus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): blade ovate to rhombic-ovate; FOC ovate-rhombic or elliptic; Wikipedia: upper leaves lance-shaped. Rhombic has no state; ovate leads.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Amaranthus retroflexus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): blade 2-15 cm; FOC 5-12 cm.

traits.leaf_width_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Amaranthus retroflexus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): blade 1-7 cm wide; FOC 2-5 cm.

traits.petiole_length_m.note: Flora of China vol. 5 (2003), Amaranthus retroflexus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): petiole light green, 1.5-5.5 cm, hairy; FNA petiole half to equalling the blade.

traits.leaf_base_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Amaranthus retroflexus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): base cuneate to rounded-cuneate; FOC cuneate.

traits.leaf_apex.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Amaranthus retroflexus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): apex acute, obtuse or slightly emarginate, with a terminal mucro (FOC acute or notched, with a mucro).

traits.leaf_margin.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Amaranthus retroflexus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): margins entire, plane or slightly undulate.

traits.leaf_hairs.note: Flora of China vol. 5 (2003), Amaranthus retroflexus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): both surfaces shortly hairy.

traits.leaf_hairs_beneath.note: Flora of China vol. 5 (2003), Amaranthus retroflexus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): densely hairy abaxially.

traits.leaf_colour.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: no flora read names the leaf colour; a mid green, sRGB by eye.

traits.inflorescence.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Amaranthus retroflexus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): inflorescences terminal and axillary, branched, leafless at least distally, usually short and thick; FOC complex thyrsoid structures of many spikes, the terminal spike longer. Read as a panicle of dense spikes.

traits.inflorescence_posture.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Amaranthus retroflexus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): erect or reflexed at the tip; FOC erect.

traits.inflorescence_length_m.note: A model estimate (confidence low), as no source read gives it: FNA calls the inflorescences short and thick and FOC gives 2-4 cm across but no length; a terminal panicle of spikes about 5-20 cm long on a grown plant.

traits.flowering_position.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Amaranthus retroflexus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): inflorescences terminal and axillary; FEIS: often extra dense clusters in the axils of upper leaves.

traits.bract_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Amaranthus retroflexus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): each flower's bract lanceolate to subulate, (2.5-)3.5-5(-6) mm, longer than the tepals, with an excurrent spiny midrib; FOC 4-6 mm, white. These floral bracts, not inflorescence-foot bracts, give the spike its bristly look.

traits.flower_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Amaranthus retroflexus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): inflorescences green or silvery green, often with a reddish or yellowish tint; FOC tepals white with a green midvein; sRGB by eye for 'silvery green'.

traits.flower_size_m.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: tepals 2.5-3.5 mm long (FNA), so a flower about 3 mm across.

traits.perianth.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Amaranthus retroflexus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): tepals 5, membranous.

traits.perianth_parts.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Amaranthus retroflexus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): pistillate and staminate flowers with 5 tepals.

traits.flower_merosity.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Amaranthus retroflexus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): tepals 5.

traits.tepal_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Amaranthus retroflexus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): pistillate tepals (2-)2.5-3.5(-4) mm, spatulate-obovate; FOC 2-2.5 mm.

traits.stamens.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Amaranthus retroflexus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): staminate flowers few at the tips of the inflorescences; stamens (3-)4-5.

traits.carpels.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Amaranthus retroflexus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): stigmas 3; FOC stigmas 3, rarely 2.

traits.sexual_system.note: USFS FEIS, Amaranthus retroflexus species review (fs.usda.gov/database/feis/plants/forb/amaret, read 2026-10-19): monoecious; FNA staminate flowers few at the inflorescence tips.

traits.fruit_type.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Amaranthus retroflexus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): utricles with regular circumscissile dehiscence (a lid); Wikipedia calls it a capsule with a lid. Read as capsule.

traits.fruit_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Amaranthus retroflexus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): utricles broadly obovoid to broadly elliptic; FOC ovoid, compressed.

traits.fruit_size_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Amaranthus retroflexus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): utricles 1.5-2.5 mm, shorter than or about equal to the tepals.

traits.fruit_colour_ripe.note: Flora of China vol. 5 (2003), Amaranthus retroflexus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): utricles light green; sRGB by eye for the words.

traits.calyx_in_fruit.note: Flora of China vol. 5 (2003), Amaranthus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): key: fruit enveloped in the persistent perianth (A. retroflexus).

traits.flowering_months.note: USFS FEIS, Amaranthus retroflexus species review (fs.usda.gov/database/feis/plants/forb/amaret, read 2026-10-19): blooms July-October in the Great Plains, August-October in the central and northeastern US; FNA summer-fall; FOC flowering July-August.

traits.fruiting_months.note: Flora of China vol. 5 (2003), Amaranthus retroflexus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): fruiting August-September; FEIS matures late summer or early fall, so October added.

traits.elevation_min_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Amaranthus retroflexus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): 0-2500 m.

traits.elevation_max_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Amaranthus retroflexus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): 0-2500 m; FEIS records to 2804 m in Colorado.

traits.light.note: USFS FEIS, Amaranthus retroflexus species review (fs.usda.gov/database/feis/plants/forb/amaret, read 2026-10-19): an obligate initial-community species of bare, disturbed open sites.

traits.moisture.note: USFS FEIS, Amaranthus retroflexus species review (fs.usda.gov/database/feis/plants/forb/amaret, read 2026-10-19): grows in dry to moist conditions.

traits.soil_texture.note: USFS FEIS, Amaranthus retroflexus species review (fs.usda.gov/database/feis/plants/forb/amaret, read 2026-10-19): in Utah good growth on sandy loam, loam and clay, fair on sandy and clay-loam soils, poor on gravel and dense clay.

traits.habitat_notes.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Amaranthus retroflexus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): banks of rivers, lakes and streams, disturbed habitats, agricultural fields, railroads, roadsides, waste areas.

traits.shoot_leaves.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read counts it: a stem 0.2-1(-2) m with alternate leaves 2-4 cm apart.

traits.inflorescence_branches.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read counts it: FNA: a dense terminal panicle of crowded spikes, with axillary spikes below; 5-15 spikes in the terminal one.

traits.inflorescence_branch_kind.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Amaranthus retroflexus (read 2026-10-19): inflorescences terminal and axillary, the terminal one a dense panicle of thick, crowded spikes.

traits.units_per_inflorescence.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read counts it: each spike is packed with sessile flowers 2-3 mm long, a few hundred to a spike.

traits.flowering_branches.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read counts it: FNA: stems branched in the upper part, the branches ending in spikes.
